definitions.explanation: A result in a competition where neither side wins.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{引|ひ}き{分|わ}けに{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The match ended in a draw.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{分|わ}けで{勝|か}ち{点|てん}１を{得|え}た。
examples.english: We got one point from the draw.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け describes a tie or draw in competitions where neither side wins.

WORD FORMATION:
{引|ひ}く (to pull) + {分|わ}ける (to divide) — both sides pull equally

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{分|わ}けに{終|お}わる: to end in a draw
- {引|ひ}き{分|わ}けに{持|も}ち{込|こ}む: to force a draw
- 〇{対|たい}〇の{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け: a ~-~ tie

SPORTS RESULTS:
- {勝|か}ち: win
- {負|ま}け: loss
- {引|ひ}き{分|わ}け: draw/tie

NOTE:
In league standings, often abbreviated as {分|ふん} or {分|わけ}.
